hypothesis: Closed EML trees have no 1-D size complete invariant of denotation. Exhaustive n_internal≤6 enumeration is Catalan-complete. Two equal-size trees disagree at a registered point. Numerical fiber counts are computational (grid/rounding agreement is not function identity). US-4′ is withheld. Cross-size collision is recorded if found, otherwise withheld for that gate only.

controls.description: For each registered k in 0..6, the enumerated tree count must equal Catalan C_k. This is the completeness check, not a sample.
The two size-2 trees eml(1,eml(1,1)) and eml(eml(1,1),1) must evaluate to e-1 and exp(e). A single-point disagreement is a witness, not a collision.
eml(1,1)=e, leaf=1, eml(1,eml(eml(1,1),1))=0, and the registered identity-1 tree equals 1.
On the registered (x,y) grid with y>0, eml(x,y) equals exp(x)-ln(y) exactly in float.
The summary must record that finite-grid or rounded agreement is not function identity.
The summary must flag US-4′ untested. Truncated Gibbs mass is not that claim.
Optional cross-size credit requires a well-resolved fiber or a registered algebraic identity. Extreme-magnitude float collisions do not count.

gates.criterion: Two equal-size trees have different closed eval at the registered point (1,1). Registered pair: eml(1,eml(1,1)) versus eml(eml(1,1),1).
Tree count at each k in 0..6 equals Catalan C_k.
Summary records that grid or rounding agreement is not function identity.
Optional. Pass if a well-resolved or exact cross-size identity is observed; otherwise status=withheld. Never fails the package.
